question: Enzyme Linked Immuno-Sorbent Assay (ELISA) is a diagnostic test for:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Acquired Immuno Deficiency Syndrome.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Enzyme-Linked Immuno-Sorbent Assay (ELISA) is a diagnostic test for Acquired immunodeficiency syndrome.
 
• **People with acquired immunodeficiency syndrome **are more likely to contract infections and some malignancies, which typically only affect people with compromised immune systems.** **
 
• **Acquired immunodeficiency syndrome** can be identified using an enzyme-linked** immunosorbent test **(AIDS).
 
• To** detect HIV infection,** the enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) test is** widely utilised.**
